grammar_title: 限制性定语从句:关系代词 that / which / who / whom / whose
source: 人教版2019必修一 Unit 4 Discovering Useful Structures:限制性定语从句(关系代词 that/which/who/whose/whom)。句子地道、答案唯一(选项排除其他成立项)。

points.point: 指人:who(主格)/ whom(宾格·介词后)
points.overview: 先行词指人:作从句主语用 who;作宾语、尤其紧跟介词时用 whom(to/with/for whom)。

points.point: 指物:which / that(及 that 必用情形)
points.overview: 先行词指物用 which/that;先行词被 all/everything/nothing/the only/序数词/最高级 等修饰,或为不定代词时只能用 that;介词后只能用 which(不可 that)。

points.point: whose(所属)+ 介词 + whom / which
points.overview: 表所属关系用 whose(指人或物);介词提到从句句首时,指人用 whom、指物用 which。

questions.stem: "The villagers ____ lived near the river were warned in time."
questions.explanation: 先行词 villagers 指人、作从句主语 → who。

questions.stem: "The soldiers ____ dug out the survivors worked for days."
questions.explanation: 指人作主语 → who。

questions.stem: "Doctors and nurses ____ came to help saved many lives."
questions.explanation: 指人作主语 → who。

questions.stem: "A boy ____ saved several classmates became a hero."
questions.explanation: 指人作主语 → who。

questions.stem: "The people ____ lost their homes were given shelter."
questions.explanation: 指人作主语 → who。

questions.stem: "Volunteers ____ arrived from other cities brought food and water."
questions.explanation: 指人作主语 → who。

questions.stem: "The man ____ warned the village is respected by everyone."
questions.explanation: 指人作主语 → who。

questions.stem: "Children ____ were left without parents needed special care."
questions.explanation: 指人作主语 → who。

questions.stem: "The captain ____ led the rescue team never lost heart."
questions.explanation: 指人作主语 → who。

questions.stem: "Survivors ____ were trapped under the ruins called for help."
questions.explanation: 指人作主语 → who。

questions.stem: "The soldier to ____ she wrote a thank-you letter had saved her."
questions.explanation: 介词 to 后指人 → whom(不可 who/that)。

questions.stem: "The doctor with ____ James used to work died in the quake."
questions.explanation: 介词 with 后指人 → whom。

questions.stem: "The neighbours for ____ they built shelters were very grateful."
questions.explanation: 介词 for 后指人 → whom。

questions.stem: "The expert to ____ we listened explained the warning signs."
questions.explanation: 介词 to 后指人 → whom。

questions.stem: "The friends on ____ she depended helped her rebuild her home."
questions.explanation: 介词 on 后指人 → whom(depend on)。

questions.stem: "The official from ____ we got the news arrived very quickly."
questions.explanation: 介词 from 后指人 → whom。

questions.stem: "The teacher with ____ the students sheltered stayed brave."
questions.explanation: 介词 with 后指人 → whom。

questions.stem: "The pilot to ____ they waved flew the helicopter lower."
questions.explanation: 介词 to 后指人 → whom。

questions.stem: "The rescuer to ____ she owed her life later became her friend."
questions.explanation: 介词 to 后指人 → whom(owe sth to sb)。

questions.stem: "The nurse for ____ the boy waited finally came back."
questions.explanation: 介词 for 后指人 → whom。

questions.stem: "Everything ____ stood in the city was destroyed in one minute."
questions.explanation: 先行词为不定代词 everything → 只能用 that。

questions.stem: "The only building ____ remained safe was the school."
questions.explanation: 先行词被 the only 修饰 → 只能用 that。

questions.stem: "This was the worst disaster ____ the country had ever seen."
questions.explanation: 先行词被最高级 worst 修饰 → 只能用 that。

questions.stem: "The first thing ____ they did was call for help."
questions.explanation: 先行词被序数词 first 修饰 → 只能用 that。

questions.stem: "All the food ____ was left went to the children."
questions.explanation: 先行词被 all 修饰 → 只能用 that。

questions.stem: "There was nothing ____ could be done that terrible night."
questions.explanation: 先行词为不定代词 nothing → 只能用 that。

questions.stem: "It was the largest earthquake ____ had ever hit the area."
questions.explanation: 先行词被最高级 largest 修饰 → 只能用 that。

questions.stem: "The few houses ____ were still standing became shelters."
questions.explanation: 先行词被 few 修饰 → 用 that。

questions.stem: "Everything ____ the flood touched was ruined."
questions.explanation: 不定代词 everything 作先行词 → that。

questions.stem: "The second city ____ was hit by the quake was Beijing."
questions.explanation: 先行词被序数词 second 修饰 → that。

questions.stem: "The narrow path along ____ they escaped led to the hills."
questions.explanation: 介词 along 后指物 → 只能用 which(不可 that)。

questions.stem: "The well from ____ smelly gas came was near the village."
questions.explanation: 介词 from 后指物 → which。

questions.stem: "The train on ____ the supplies arrived was badly delayed."
questions.explanation: 介词 on 后指物 → which。

questions.stem: "The shelter in ____ they slept was made of wood."
questions.explanation: 介词 in 后指物 → which。

questions.stem: "The bridge over ____ they crossed soon fell down."
questions.explanation: 介词 over 后指物 → which。

questions.stem: "The boxes in ____ the medicine came were very heavy."
questions.explanation: 介词 in 后指物 → which。

questions.stem: "It was the most powerful quake ____ they had ever felt."
questions.explanation: 先行词被最高级 most powerful 修饰 → that。

questions.stem: "The only road ____ was still open led up to the hills."
questions.explanation: 先行词被 the only 修饰 → that。

questions.stem: "This is the very spot ____ the tornado struck first."
questions.explanation: 先行词被 the very 修饰 → that。

questions.stem: "All ____ remained were broken bricks and pieces of metal."
questions.explanation: 先行词为不定代词 all → 只能用 that。

questions.stem: "Workers built shelters for survivors ____ homes had been destroyed."
questions.explanation: 表所属(survivors 的 homes)→ whose。

questions.stem: "The boy ____ mother was lost in the disaster was taken to hospital."
questions.explanation: 表所属(boy 的 mother)→ whose。

questions.stem: "An architect ____ designs won praise rebuilt the new town."
questions.explanation: 表所属(architect 的 designs)→ whose。

questions.stem: "The families ____ houses fell down moved to safe areas."
questions.explanation: 表所属 → whose。

questions.stem: "The girl ____ leg was injured was rescued first."
questions.explanation: 表所属(girl 的 leg)→ whose。

questions.stem: "A scientist ____ research warned of the quake became famous."
questions.explanation: 表所属(scientist 的 research)→ whose。

questions.stem: "The town ____ buildings were earthquake-safe survived well."
questions.explanation: 表所属(town 的 buildings,whose 也可指物)→ whose。

questions.stem: "People ____ relatives were missing waited at the gate."
questions.explanation: 表所属 → whose。

questions.stem: "The man ____ shop was ruined by the flood started again."
questions.explanation: 表所属 → whose。

questions.stem: "The village ____ wells dried up needed water badly."
questions.explanation: 表所属(village 的 wells)→ whose。

questions.stem: "The doctor with ____ he had worked for years died in the quake."
questions.explanation: 介词 with 后指人 → whom。

questions.stem: "The strong building in ____ they took shelter did not fall."
questions.explanation: 介词 in 后指物 → which。

questions.stem: "The soldiers on ____ the city depended arrived very fast."
questions.explanation: 介词 on 后指人 → whom(depend on)。

questions.stem: "The river into ____ the heavy rain fell soon flooded the town."
questions.explanation: 介词 into 后指物 → which。

questions.stem: "The hills to ____ they ran were safe and dry."
questions.explanation: 介词 to 后指物 → which。

questions.stem: "The friends with ____ they shared their food became very close."
questions.explanation: 介词 with 后指人 → whom。

questions.stem: "The leader in ____ everyone trusted stayed calm and brave."
questions.explanation: 介词 in 后指人 → whom(trust in)。

questions.stem: "The plane from ____ the aid was dropped flew very low."
questions.explanation: 介词 from 后指物 → which。

questions.stem: "The nurse to ____ the boy owed his life visited him later."
questions.explanation: 介词 to 后指人 → whom。

questions.stem: "The family ____ car was swept away had to walk to safety."
questions.explanation: 表所属(family 的 car)→ whose。
